summary: Five frozen RB2 paper identities are probed via Europe PMC index metadata. A validated OA/PMCID result yields a *candidate link*; it never proves actual inspectable content, licensed redistribution, peer review, per-arm statistics or eligible model rows.
access_workflow: Lookup exact MED record by frozen PMID
Require matching DOI, PMID and source
Use Europe PMC isOpenAccess and PMCID only to identify a candidate repository route
Report unknown/non-indexed/provider errors without asserting absence of a legal fulltext copy
Require human original figure/table and license checks before E1/E7 evidence proposals
No model execution, dataset mutation, or automated evidence promotion
required_external_human_action: Legally inspect the original article and evidence figure/table, record per-arm exposure, comparator, assay, readout time and source statistics in separate E1 drafts, then adjudicate separately.
